Plugin Loader
=============

The loader every plugin runs on (version.dll). On its own it does nothing visible.

NEEDS: Nothing.
WORKS WITH: Every Motor Town plugin needs it: install it once, then add the plugins you want.

FILES:
  MotorTown\Binaries\Win64\version.dll

HOW TO INSTALL
1. In Steam, right-click Motor Town > Manage > Browse local files.
2. Drag the MotorTown folder from this download into that window and let it merge.

SOURCE
  https://github.com/qxZap/mt-plugin-loader -- this download was built there from that source.
  SHA256SUMS.txt in the same GitHub release lists the dll's hash.
